lines.t: I've seen the sunrise through the rain You were there through loss and gain
Every storm that washed my name You whispered faith and stayed the same
When shadows lingered on my skin
Your mercy pulled the light back in
Grace rewove what fear had torn
And love rebuilt what once was worn
I could never drift too far
You found me right where my heart scars
Every time I fall apart
You write new light inside the dark
Yahushua, your love won't end
It circles, time begins again
Higher than the stars above
Forever held in endless love
No mountain high, no ocean deep
Could take me from the heart that keeps
In every breath I feel enough
Yeah, who's true, your endless love
When silence feels too loud to bear
I find your voice is always there
Unrushed hands and eyes that see
You pour out peace relentlessly
You turn my fear into release
You turn my striving into peace
Now every step a song of trust
My hope restored in You, my must
Love without end, just love without end
Closer than breath, more faithful than friends
Every heartbeat calls Your name
Yahushua, Your love won't fade
In every light, in every shade
It burns through time, it rises high
An endless flame that fills the sky
No head, no fear, just grace and love
Yeah, who's sure your endless love
Forever found, forever true
I live because of you
